cohort: 102 neonates diagnosed with transient tachypnea of newborn (TTN), born between 34 to 42 weeks of gestation, admitted to the Department of Pediatrics at a rural tertiary care teaching centre.
finding: Transient tachypnea of newborn (TTN) is a common respiratory disorder with risk factors including cesarean section, preterm delivery, male gender, and maternal comorbidities, and it generally has an excellent prognosis with low mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a significant risk factor for transient tachypnea of newborn, with 77.5% of affected neonates delivered this way.
